single_question: Does the training gain of a fixed TrivialAugmentWide policy materially change when backbone representation weights learn, compared with a frozen-backbone control?
scientific_role: Calibrate whether frozen-feature pilot conclusions transfer to feature-learning training. This is not proposed as a new augmentation algorithm or a proven original causal contribution.

reporting: report four cells and bothaugmentation gains G separately; a positiveD alone is not useful if finetuning gains are negative
paired source-photo bootstrap CI on mean-seed D plus all3seed effects; do not treat3x3541 as independent observations
0.05nat prespecified practical interaction margin; CIs crossing meaningful positive/negative effects mean inconclusive, not no effect
accuracy/breedmacroaccuracy and trainconvergence as secondary outcomes; no outcome-driven checkpoints or test-selected hyperparameters
novelty_boundary: TA already evaluates trained networks; ForAug already reports representation-pretraining/fine-tuning gains. This matched4cell proxy-validity question provides local measurement information; no exhaustive novelty claim or new causal method.
